description: This file contains the implementation of the CCalcEngine class, including global constants, constructor, initialization methods, and resource management functions for a calculator engine component.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main class implementing calculator engine logic, including resource management, number formatting, and calculation state.

methods.name: LoadEngineStrings
methods.description: Loads localized strings for engine from resource provider.

methods.name: InitialOneTimeOnlySetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup of constants and resource strings.

methods.name: CCalcEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calculator engine with configuration parameters.

methods.name: InitChopNumbers
methods.description: Initializes number chopping constants based on supported bit widths.

methods.name: GetChopNumber
methods.description: Returns the current chop number based on number width.

methods.name: GetMaxDecimalValueString
methods.description: Returns the maximum decimal value string for current number width.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject
methods.description: Returns a unique pointer to the current memory object for persistence.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject
methods.description: Sets the memory object from a given Rational value.

methods.name: SettingsChanged
methods.description: Updates calculator settings based on resource strings and triggers display refresh if needed.

methods.name: DecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the current decimal separator character.

methods.name: GetHistoryCollectorCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current history commands, including the current operand if not added.
